query.text: 请帮我照看孩子，有危险或异常情况及时通知我。
query.text_en: Please help me watch the child and notify me immediately if there is any danger or abnormal situation.

annotation.text_zh: 孩子在爬电视柜抓电视，容易砸伤，快去看看
annotation.text_en: The child is climbing the TV stand and grabbing the TV, go check before it falls!

annotation.text_zh: 孩子在用扫把戳电视屏幕，快去阻止他们
annotation.text_en: The child is poking the TV screen with a broom, go stop them!

annotation.text_zh: 电视屏幕黑了，可能被孩子戳坏了
annotation.text_en: The TV screen went black, a kid might have broken it.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
